from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

select_all = fluentqt.CheckBox("Select all")
select_all.setTristate(True)
mail = fluentqt.CheckBox("Mail")
calendar = fluentqt.CheckBox("Calendar")
people = fluentqt.CheckBox("People")

def update_select_all():
    checked = sum(item.isChecked() for item in (mail, calendar, people))
    state = (
        Qt.CheckState.Unchecked if checked == 0
        else Qt.CheckState.Checked if checked == 3
        else Qt.CheckState.PartiallyChecked
    )
    select_all.setCheckState(state)

def apply_select_all():
    checked = select_all.checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked
    mail.setChecked(checked)
    calendar.setChecked(checked)
    people.setChecked(checked)

select_all.clicked.connect(apply_select_all)
mail.clicked.connect(update_select_all)
calendar.clicked.connect(update_select_all)
people.clicked.connect(update_select_all)

from PySide6.QtCore import QFileInfo, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QStandardItem, QStandardItemModel
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFileDialog, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

panel = QWidget()
layout = QVBoxLayout(panel)
layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
layout.setSpacing(24)
model = QStandardItemModel(panel)
roles = fluentqt.FileListView.DataRole
states = fluentqt.FileListView.Status

def add_file(name, detail, state, progress):
    item = QStandardItem(name)
    item.setData(detail, roles.MetadataRole)
    item.setData(state, roles.StatusRole)
    item.setData(progress, roles.ProgressRole)
    model.appendRow(item)

add_file("brand-guidelines.pdf", "2.4 MB · Ready to use", states.Ready, 1.0)
add_file("product-shot.png", "3.6 / 5.8 MB · Uploading", states.Uploading, 0.62)
add_file("archive.zip", "28 MB · Exceeds the 20 MB limit", states.Rejected, 0.0)
drop = fluentqt.FileDropZone(panel)
drop.setObjectName("fileDropZone")
drop.setDescription("Add documents, images or a ZIP archive.")
drop.setHintText("PDF, PNG, JPG, ZIP · Up to 20 MB per file")
layout.addWidget(drop)
heading = fluentqt.Label("Files", panel)
heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
layout.addWidget(heading)

files = fluentqt.FileListView(panel)
files.setObjectName("selectedFiles")
files.setAccessibleName("Selected files")
files.setBackgroundVisible(False)
files.setBorderVisible(False)
files.setProperty("fluentPreserveParentSurface", True)
files.viewport().setProperty("fluentPreserveParentSurface", True)
files.setMinimumHeight(260)
files.setModel(model)
layout.addWidget(files)
files.removeRequested.connect(lambda index: model.removeRow(index.row()))

def accept_file(path):
    file = QFileInfo(path)
    if not file.isFile():
        return
    type_allowed = file.suffix().lower() in ("pdf", "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "zip")
    size_allowed = file.size() <= 20 * 1024 * 1024
    if not type_allowed or not size_allowed:
        reason = "Choose a file under 20 MB."
        if not type_allowed:
            reason = "This file type is not supported."
        drop.setErrorMessage(file.fileName() + " · " + reason)
        add_file(file.fileName(), reason, states.Rejected, 0.0)
        return
    drop.clearError()
    detail = f"{file.size() / (1024 * 1024):.1f} MB · Ready to use"
    add_file(file.fileName(), detail, states.Ready, 1.0)

def dropped(urls):
    for url in urls:
        accept_file(url.toLocalFile())

def browse():
    dialog = QFileDialog(panel, "Choose files")
    dialog.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_DeleteOnClose)
    dialog.setFileMode(QFileDialog.FileMode.ExistingFiles)
    dialog.setNameFilter("Documents (*.pdf *.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.zip)")
    dialog.filesSelected.connect(
        lambda paths: [accept_file(path) for path in paths]
    )
    dialog.open()
    panel._file_dialog = dialog

drop.filesDropped.connect(dropped)
drop.browseRequested.connect(browse)

import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
application = QApplication.instance()
if application is None:
    fluentqt.prepare_high_dpi_application()
    application = QApplication([])
    fluentqt.initialize_resources()
    application.setFont(fluentqt.font_for_role(fluentqt.FontRole.Body))
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QWidget
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QStandardItem, QStandardItemModel

root = QWidget(globals().get('gallery_parent'))
root.setObjectName("teamSelectionSample")
root.setMaximumWidth(392)
body = QVBoxLayout(root)
body.setContentsMargins(16, 16, 16, 16)
body.setSpacing(12)

model = QStandardItemModel(root)
def team(key, name):
    entry = QStandardItem(name)
    entry.setData(key, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
    return entry

product = team("product", "Product engineering")
product.setSelectable(False)
product.appendRow(team("client", "Client apps"))
product.appendRow(team("platform", "Platform services"))
product.appendRow(team("product-design", "Design"))
brand = team("brand", "Brand and marketing")
brand.setSelectable(False)
brand.appendRow(team("content", "Content"))
brand.appendRow(team("brand-design", "Design"))
archived = team("archived", "Archived team")
archived.setEnabled(False)
model.appendRow(product)
model.appendRow(brand)
model.appendRow(archived)

owner = fluentqt.TreeSelect(root)
owner.setObjectName("projectOwningTeam")
owner.setAccessibleName("Owning team")
owner.setModel(model)
owner.setPlaceholderText("Search teams…")
owner.setSelectedKeys(["client"])
owner_field = fluentqt.Field(root)
owner_field.setLabelText("Owning team")
owner_field.setEditor(owner)
body.addWidget(owner_field)

collaborators = fluentqt.TreeSelect(root)
collaborators.setObjectName("projectCollaboratingTeams")
collaborators.setAccessibleName("Collaborating teams")
collaborators.setModel(model)
collaborators.setSelectionMode(fluentqt.TreeSelect.SelectionMode.Multiple)
collaborators.setPlaceholderText("Add teams…")
collaborators.setSelectedKeys(["brand-design"])
collaborators_field = fluentqt.Field(root)
collaborators_field.setLabelText("Collaborating teams")
collaborators_field.setEditor(collaborators)
collaborators_field.setHelperText("Search by team or department. Select teams independently.")
body.addWidget(collaborators_field)

status = fluentqt.Label(root)
status.setObjectName("teamSelectionStatus")
status.setWordWrap(True)
status.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
status.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
body.addWidget(status)
active = [True]
root.destroyed.connect(lambda _object=None, active=active: active.__setitem__(0, False))
def update_status(active=active, owner=owner, collaborators=collaborators, status=status):
    if not active[0]:
        return
    own = owner.selectedItems()
    paths = []
    for entry in collaborators.selectedItems():
        paths.append(entry["path"])
    primary = own[0]["path"] if own else "Not assigned"
    status.setText("Owner: " + primary + "\nCollaborators: " + ("; ".join(paths) or "None"))

owner.selectionChanged.connect(update_status)
collaborators.selectionChanged.connect(update_status)
actions = QHBoxLayout()
read_only = fluentqt.CheckBox("Read only", root)
read_only.setObjectName("teamReadOnly")
read_only.toggled.connect(owner.setReadOnly)
read_only.toggled.connect(collaborators.setReadOnly)
actions.addWidget(read_only)
actions.addStretch()
clear = fluentqt.Button("Clear", root)
clear.setObjectName("teamClear")
clear.clicked.connect(owner.clearSelection)
clear.clicked.connect(collaborators.clearSelection)
read_only.toggled.connect(lambda checked, clear=clear: clear.setEnabled(not checked))
actions.addWidget(clear)
body.addLayout(actions)
update_status()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root.show()
    application.exec()

import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
fluentqt.prepare_high_dpi_application()
application = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

root = QWidget(globals().get("gallery_parent"))
layout = QVBoxLayout(root)
layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
layout.setSpacing(12)
open_button = fluentqt.Button("Preview background effects", root)
open_button.setObjectName("Gallery.Drawer.OpenEffects")
open_button.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
layout.addWidget(open_button, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
hint = fluentqt.Label(
    "Open the overlay to try this action.", root
)
hint.setWordWrap(True)
hint.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
layout.addWidget(hint)
row = QHBoxLayout()
counter = fluentqt.Button("Background action", root)
counter.setObjectName("Gallery.Drawer.Background")
row.addWidget(counter)
status = fluentqt.Label("Background clicks: 0", root)
status.setObjectName("Gallery.Drawer.Status")
status.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
row.addWidget(status)
row.addStretch()
layout.addLayout(row)
count = 0
def count_background():
    global count
    count += 1
    status.setText(f"Background clicks: {count}")
counter.clicked.connect(count_background)

def open_effects():
    overlay = fluentqt.DrawerView(root)
    overlay.setObjectName("Gallery.Drawer.Effects")
    overlay.setModal(True)
    overlay.setDim(True)
    overlay.setDimOpacity(0.12)
    overlay.setBackdropBlurRadius(8)
    overlay.setClosePolicy(fluentqt.DrawerView.CloseOnEscape)
    overlay.setEdge(fluentqt.DrawerView.DrawerEdge.Right)
    overlay.setDrawerLength(320)
    overlay.setInteractive(False)
    body = QWidget()
    overlay.setOwnedContentWidget(body)
    content = QVBoxLayout(body)
    content.setContentsMargins(28, 26, 28, 26)
    content.setSpacing(10)
    title = fluentqt.Label("Modal and backdrop effects", body)
    title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
    title.setWordWrap(True)
    content.addWidget(title)
    modal = fluentqt.CheckBox("Modal", body)
    modal.setObjectName("Gallery.Drawer.Modal")
    modal.setChecked(True)
    modal.toggled.connect(overlay.setModal)
    def explain_modal(enabled):
        hint.setText(
            "Modal on: background blocked." if enabled else
            "Modal off: background available."
        )
    modal.toggled.connect(explain_modal)
    explain_modal(True)
    content.addWidget(modal)
    dim_enabled = fluentqt.CheckBox("Dim background", body)
    dim_enabled.setObjectName("Gallery.Drawer.DimEnabled")
    dim_enabled.setChecked(True)
    dim_enabled.toggled.connect(overlay.setDim)
    content.addWidget(dim_enabled)
    outside = fluentqt.CheckBox("Close on outside click", body)
    outside.setObjectName("Gallery.Drawer.CloseOutside")
    def set_outside_close(enabled):
        policy = fluentqt.DrawerView.CloseOnEscape
        if enabled:
            policy |= fluentqt.DrawerView.CloseOnPressOutside
        overlay.setClosePolicy(fluentqt.DrawerView.ClosePolicy(policy))
    outside.toggled.connect(set_outside_close)
    content.addWidget(outside)
    blur_label = fluentqt.Label("Blur: 8 px", body)
    blur = fluentqt.Slider(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal, body)
    blur.setObjectName("Gallery.Drawer.Blur")
    blur.setAccessibleName("Background blur radius")
    blur.setRange(0, 24)
    blur.setValue(8)
    def update_blur(value):
        overlay.setBackdropBlurRadius(value)
        blur_label.setText(f"Blur: {value} px")
    blur.valueChanged.connect(update_blur)
    content.addWidget(blur_label)
    content.addWidget(blur)
    dim_label = fluentqt.Label("Dim: 12%", body)
    dim = fluentqt.Slider(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal, body)
    dim.setObjectName("Gallery.Drawer.Dim")
    dim.setAccessibleName("Background dim opacity")
    dim.setRange(0, 60)
    dim.setValue(12)
    def update_dim(value):
        overlay.setDimOpacity(value / 100.0)
        dim_label.setText(f"Dim: {value}%")
    dim.valueChanged.connect(update_dim)
    content.addWidget(dim_label)
    content.addWidget(dim)
    close = fluentqt.Button("Close", body)
    close.setObjectName("Gallery.Drawer.Close")
    close.clicked.connect(lambda: overlay.setIsOpen(False))
    content.addWidget(close, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight)
    content.addStretch()
    counter.clicked.connect(overlay.refreshBackdrop)
    overlay.closed.connect(lambda: hint.setText(
        "Open the overlay to try this action."
    ))
    overlay.closed.connect(overlay.deleteLater)
    overlay.open()
open_button.clicked.connect(open_effects)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root.show()
    application.exec()

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QStandardItem, QStandardItemModel
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout, QWidget

panel = QWidget()
layout = QVBoxLayout(panel)
layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
layout.setSpacing(24)
model = QStandardItemModel(panel)
roles = fluentqt.FileListView.DataRole
states = fluentqt.FileListView.Status

def add_file(name, detail, state, progress):
    item = QStandardItem(name)
    item.setData(detail, roles.MetadataRole)
    item.setData(state, roles.StatusRole)
    item.setData(progress, roles.ProgressRole)
    model.appendRow(item)

add_file("brand-guidelines.pdf", "2.4 MB · Ready to use", states.Ready, 1.0)
add_file("product-shot.png", "3.6 / 5.8 MB · Uploading", states.Uploading, 0.62)
add_file(
    "research-notes-for-the-autumn-product-release-and-accessibility-review.pdf",
    "Connection lost · Retry when you are ready",
    states.Rejected,
    0.0
)
model.item(2).setData(True, roles.RetryableRole)

files = fluentqt.FileListView(panel)
files.setObjectName("selectedFiles")
files.setAccessibleName("Selected files")
files.setBackgroundVisible(False)
files.setBorderVisible(False)
files.setProperty("fluentPreserveParentSurface", True)
files.viewport().setProperty("fluentPreserveParentSurface", True)
files.setMinimumHeight(260)
files.setModel(model)
layout.addWidget(files)
files.removeRequested.connect(lambda index: model.removeRow(index.row()))

panel.setMaximumWidth(720)
layout.setSpacing(16)
files.setObjectName("fileList")
files.setAccessibleName("Transfer examples")
files.setMinimumHeight(240)

def retry(index):
    model.setData(index, states.Uploading, roles.StatusRole)
    model.setData(index, False, roles.RetryableRole)
    model.setData(
        index,
        "Reconnected · Uploading",
        roles.MetadataRole
    )
    model.setData(index, 0.0, roles.ProgressRole)

files.retryRequested.connect(retry)
advance = fluentqt.Button("Advance example transfers", panel)
advance.setObjectName("advanceTransfer")
advance.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Subtle)

def advance_transfers():
    for row in range(model.rowCount()):
        index = model.index(row, 0)
        if index.data(roles.StatusRole) != states.Uploading:
            continue
        progress = min(1.0, float(index.data(roles.ProgressRole)) + 0.19)
        model.setData(index, progress, roles.ProgressRole)
        model.setData(
            index,
            "Ready to use" if progress >= 1 else "Uploading",
            roles.MetadataRole
        )

import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
fluentqt.prepare_high_dpi_application()
application = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

root = QWidget(globals().get("gallery_parent"))
layout = QVBoxLayout(root)
layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
layout.setSpacing(12)
open_button = fluentqt.Button("Preview background effects", root)
open_button.setObjectName("Gallery.Dialog.OpenEffects")
open_button.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
layout.addWidget(open_button, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
hint = fluentqt.Label(
    "Open the overlay to try this action.", root
)
hint.setWordWrap(True)
hint.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
layout.addWidget(hint)
row = QHBoxLayout()
counter = fluentqt.Button("Background action", root)
counter.setObjectName("Gallery.Dialog.Background")
row.addWidget(counter)
status = fluentqt.Label("Background clicks: 0", root)
status.setObjectName("Gallery.Dialog.Status")
status.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
row.addWidget(status)
row.addStretch()
layout.addLayout(row)
count = 0
def count_background():
    global count
    count += 1
    status.setText(f"Background clicks: {count}")
counter.clicked.connect(count_background)

def open_effects():
    overlay = fluentqt.Dialog(root)
    overlay.setObjectName("Gallery.Dialog.Effects")
    overlay.setModal(True)
    overlay.setDim(True)
    overlay.setDimOpacity(0.12)
    overlay.setBackdropBlurRadius(8)
    overlay.setClosePolicy(fluentqt.Dialog.CloseOnEscape)
    overlay.setThemeSource(open_button)
    overlay.setFixedWidth(400)
    body = overlay
    content = QVBoxLayout(body)
    content.setContentsMargins(28, 26, 28, 26)
    content.setSpacing(10)
    title = fluentqt.Label("Modal and backdrop effects", body)
    title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
    title.setWordWrap(True)
    content.addWidget(title)
    modal = fluentqt.CheckBox("Modal", body)
    modal.setObjectName("Gallery.Dialog.Modal")
    modal.setChecked(True)
    modal.toggled.connect(overlay.setModal)
    def explain_modal(enabled):
        hint.setText(
            "Modal on: background blocked." if enabled else
            "Modal off: background available."
        )
    modal.toggled.connect(explain_modal)
    explain_modal(True)
    content.addWidget(modal)
    dim_enabled = fluentqt.CheckBox("Dim background", body)
    dim_enabled.setObjectName("Gallery.Dialog.DimEnabled")
    dim_enabled.setChecked(True)
    dim_enabled.toggled.connect(overlay.setDim)
    content.addWidget(dim_enabled)
    outside = fluentqt.CheckBox("Close on outside click", body)
    outside.setObjectName("Gallery.Dialog.CloseOutside")
    def set_outside_close(enabled):
        policy = fluentqt.Dialog.CloseOnEscape
        if enabled:
            policy |= fluentqt.Dialog.CloseOnPressOutside
        overlay.setClosePolicy(fluentqt.Dialog.ClosePolicy(policy))
    outside.toggled.connect(set_outside_close)
    content.addWidget(outside)
    blur_label = fluentqt.Label("Blur: 8 px", body)
    blur = fluentqt.Slider(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal, body)
    blur.setObjectName("Gallery.Dialog.Blur")
    blur.setAccessibleName("Background blur radius")
    blur.setRange(0, 24)
    blur.setValue(8)
    def update_blur(value):
        overlay.setBackdropBlurRadius(value)
        blur_label.setText(f"Blur: {value} px")
    blur.valueChanged.connect(update_blur)
    content.addWidget(blur_label)
    content.addWidget(blur)
    dim_label = fluentqt.Label("Dim: 12%", body)
    dim = fluentqt.Slider(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal, body)
    dim.setObjectName("Gallery.Dialog.Dim")
    dim.setAccessibleName("Background dim opacity")
    dim.setRange(0, 60)
    dim.setValue(12)
    def update_dim(value):
        overlay.setDimOpacity(value / 100.0)

open_button.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
layout.addWidget(open_button, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
hint = fluentqt.Label(
    "Open the overlay to try this action.", root

status.setObjectName("Gallery.Popup.Status")
status.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
row.addWidget(status)
row.addStretch()

count = 0
def count_background():
    global count
    count += 1
    status.setText(f"Background clicks: {count}")

def open_effects():
    overlay = fluentqt.Popup(root)

    modal = fluentqt.CheckBox("Modal", body)

    modal.setChecked(True)
    modal.toggled.connect(overlay.setModal)
    def explain_modal(enabled):
        hint.setText(
            "Modal on: background blocked." if enabled else
            "Modal off: background available."
        )
    modal.toggled.connect(explain_modal)
    explain_modal(True)
    content.addWidget(modal)
    dim_enabled = fluentqt.CheckBox("Dim background", body)

    overlay.open()
open_button.clicked.connect(open_effects)

import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
application = QApplication.instance()
if application is None:
    fluentqt.prepare_high_dpi_application()
    application = QApplication([])
    fluentqt.initialize_resources()

from PySide6.QtCore import QMarginsF, QPointF, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QSizePolicy, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from PySide6.QtCore import QMargins, QTimer, QUrl
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QBoxLayout

class ConnectionForm(fluentqt.Card):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("connectionForm")
        self.setMaximumWidth(560)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Maximum)
        self.body = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.body.setContentsMargins(32, 32, 32, 32)
        self.body.setSpacing(24)
        self.body.setAlignment(Qt.AlignTop)
        heading = QWidget(self)
        header = QVBoxLayout(heading)
        header.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        header.setSpacing(8)
        header.addWidget(self.label("Connection settings", fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle))
        header.addWidget(self.label(
            "Configure the endpoint used by this workspace.", fluentqt.FontRole.Body, True))
        self.body.addWidget(heading)
        self.form = fluentqt.FormController(self)
        self.form.setObjectName("connectionFormController")
        self.editors = {}
        self.add_field("name", "Connection name",
            "A name to identify this connection.", "Production API")
        self.add_field("address", "Server address",
            "Use HTTPS. Try offline.example to see a connection error.",
            "https://api.example.com/v1")
        self.add_field("token", "API token", "Use any 8 characters in this demo.", "", True)
        self.status = self.label("No unsaved changes", fluentqt.FontRole.Caption, True)
        self.status.setObjectName("connectionStatus")
        self.status.setMinimumHeight(16)
        self.body.addWidget(self.status)
        actions = QWidget(self)
        self.actions = QBoxLayout(QBoxLayout.LeftToRight, actions)
        self.actions.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.actions.setSpacing(8)
        self.test_button = fluentqt.Button("Test connection", actions)
        self.test_button.setObjectName("connectionTest")
        self.save_button = fluentqt.Button("Save connection", actions)
        self.save_button.setObjectName("connectionSave")
        self.save_button.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
        self.actions.addWidget(self.test_button)
        self.actions.addWidget(self.save_button)
        self.body.addWidget(actions)
        self.body.addWidget(self.label(
            "Local demo · no credentials are sent or stored.", fluentqt.FontRole.Caption, True))
        self.form.validationRequested.connect(self.validate_field)
        self.form.submitRequested.connect(lambda token: self.later(
            450, lambda: self.form.completeSubmit(token, True)))
        self.form.stateChanged.connect(self.update_status)
        self.form.submissionFinished.connect(lambda success:
            fluentqt.Toast.showOrUpdateToast(
                self, "gallery.action-feedback", "Connection saved for this demo",
                fluentqt.Toast.Success, 2200, fluentqt.Toast.Top,
                QMargins(16, 50, 16, 16),
            ) if success else None)
        self.test_button.clicked.connect(self.form.validate)
        self.save_button.clicked.connect(self.form.submit)

    def label(self, text, role, secondary=False):
        result = fluentqt.Label(text, self)
        result.setFluentTypography(role)
        result.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary if secondary
                                else fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Primary)
        result.setWordWrap(True)
        return result

    def add_field(self, key, title, helper, value, secret=False):
        field = fluentqt.Field(self)
        field.setObjectName("connectionField_" + key)
        field.setLabelText(title)
        field.setHelperText(helper)
        editor = fluentqt.PasswordBox() if secret else fluentqt.LineEdit()
        editor.setObjectName("connectionInput_" + key)
        editor.setText(value)
        editor.setMinimumHeight(fluentqt.Spacing.ControlHeight.Standard)
        if secret:
            editor.setPlaceholderText("Enter a demo token")
        field.setOwnedEditor(editor)
        self.body.addWidget(field)
        self.editors[key] = editor
        self.form.addField(key, field)
        editor.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self.form.markFieldChanged(key))
        editor.editingFinished.connect(lambda: self.form.setFieldTouched(key))

    def later(self, delay, callback):
        timer = QTimer(self.form)
        timer.setSingleShot(True)
        def finish():
            timer.deleteLater()
            callback()
        timer.timeout.connect(finish)
        timer.start(delay)

    def validate_field(self, key, token):
        value = self.editors[key].text().strip()
        if key == "name":
            self.form.completeValidation(key, token, bool(value),
                "" if value else "Enter a connection name.")
        elif key == "token":
            self.form.completeValidation(key, token, len(value) >= 8,
                "" if len(value) >= 8 else "Enter at least 8 characters.")
        else:
            url = QUrl(value, QUrl.StrictMode)
            if not url.isValid() or url.scheme() != "https" or not url.host():
                self.form.completeValidation(key, token, False, "Enter a valid HTTPS address.")
                return
            reachable = "offline" not in value.lower()
            self.later(650, lambda: self.form.completeValidation(key, token, reachable,
                "Connection verified." if reachable else "Server unavailable. Try another address."))

    def update_status(self):
        busy = self.form.isValidating() or self.form.isSubmitting()
        self.test_button.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.save_button.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.save_button.setText("Saving…" if self.form.isSubmitting() else "Save connection")
        if self.form.isValidating():
            message = "Checking connection…"
        elif self.form.isSubmitting():
            message = "Saving connection…"
        elif self.form.errorMessages():
            message = chr(10).join(self.form.errorMessages())
        elif self.form.submissionError():
            message = self.form.submissionError()
        elif self.form.isValid():
            message = "Ready to save · unsaved changes" if self.form.isDirty() else "Connection verified."
        else:
            message = "Unsaved changes" if self.form.isDirty() else "No unsaved changes"
        self.status.setText(message)

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        narrow = self.width() < 400
        padding = 16 if narrow else 32
        self.body.setContentsMargins(padding, padding, padding, padding)
        self.actions.setDirection(QBoxLayout.TopToBottom if narrow else QBoxLayout.LeftToRight)

class LargeDataGridModel(QAbstractTableModel):
    def __init__(self, parent):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.number_font = QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.SystemFont.FixedFont)
        self.number_font.setPixelSize(parent.font().pixelSize())
        self.number_font.setStyleHint(QFont.StyleHint.Monospace)
        self.number_font.setFixedPitch(True)

    def rowCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else 100_000

    def columnCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else 5

    def data(self, index, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid():
            return None
        if (
            role == Qt.ItemDataRole.TextAlignmentRole
            and index.column() >= 3
        ):
            return Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.FontRole and index.column() >= 3:
            return self.number_font
        if role != Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            return None
        row = index.row()
        values = (
            "Build {0:06d}".format(row + 1),
            "Runner {0}".format(row % 24 + 1),
            "Queued" if row % 7 == 0 else "Complete",
            "{0} s".format(18 + row % 83),
            "{0} MB".format(42 + row % 900),
        )
        return values[index.column()]

    def headerData(self, section, orientation, role):
        if (role == Qt.ItemDataRole.TextAlignmentRole
                and orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal and section >= 3):
            return Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
        if role != Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            return None
        if orientation == Qt.Orientation.Vertical:
            return section + 1
        headers = ("Build", "Runner", "Status", "Duration", "Artifacts")
        return headers[section] if 0 <= section < len(headers) else None

    def flags(self, index):
        if not index.isValid():
            return Qt.ItemFlag.NoItemFlags
        return Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable


def make_project_data_grid_model(parent, editable):
    model = QStandardItemModel(parent)
    model.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
        ("Project", "Owner", "Status", "Priority")
    )
    model.setHeaderData(3, Qt.Orientation.Horizontal,
        int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter), Qt.ItemDataRole.TextAlignmentRole)
    projects = (
        "Aurora", "Beacon", "Canvas", "Delta",
        "Ember", "Fjord", "Grove", "Harbor",
    )
    owners = ("Maya", "Noah", "Priya", "Riley")
    for row, project in enumerate(projects):
        items = [
            QStandardItem(project),
            QStandardItem(owners[row % len(owners)]),
            QStandardItem("Review" if row % 3 == 0 else "Active"),
            QStandardItem(str(row % 4 + 1)),
        ]
        for item in items:
            item.setEditable(editable)
        items[-1].setTextAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
        )
        model.appendRow(items)
    return model

class ProjectFilterModel(QSortFilterProxyModel):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.search = ""
        self.filters = {}

    def setCriteria(self, search, filters):
        self.search = search.strip().casefold()
        self.filters = filters
        self.invalidateFilter()

    def filterAcceptsRow(self, row, parent):
        model = self.sourceModel()
        if self.search and not any(
            self.search in str(model.index(row, c, parent).data()).casefold()
            for c in range(model.columnCount(parent))
        ):
            return False
        return all(
            not self.filters.get(key)
            or model.index(row, column, parent).data() in self.filters[key]
            for key, column in (("owner", 1), ("status", 2))
        )

class DataGridWorkspaceSample(fluentqt.Card):

        title = fluentqt.Label("Projects", self)
        title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle)
        body.addWidget(title)
        description = fluentqt.Label("Search, combine filters, and arrange your columns.", self)
        description.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
        description.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
        description.setWordWrap(True)
        body.addWidget(description)
        self.toolbar = fluentqt.DataGridToolBar(self)
        self.toolbar.searchField().setPlaceholderText("Search projects…")
        self.toolbar.addFilter("status", "Status", ["Active", "Review"])

        body.addWidget(self.toolbar)
        self.model = make_project_data_grid_model(self, True)
        self.model.setHeaderData(3, Qt.Orientation.Horizontal,

        for row in range(self.model.rowCount()):
            self.model.setData(self.model.index(row, 3), row % 4 + 1, Qt.ItemDataRole.EditRole)
        self.proxy = ProjectFilterModel(self)
        self.proxy.setSourceModel(self.model)
        self.grid = fluentqt.DataGrid(self)
        self.grid.setObjectName("workspaceDataGrid")
        self.grid.setAccessibleName("Projects")
        self.grid.setModel(self.proxy)
        self.grid.setBorderVisible(False)
        self.grid.setPlaceholderText("No projects match these filters.")
        self.grid.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.grid.setSelectionMode(fluentqt.SelectionMode.Extended)
        self.grid.setSortingEnabled(True)
        self.grid.sortByColumn(0, Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder)
        self.grid.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.DoubleClicked | QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.EditKeyPressed)
        for column, width in enumerate((300, 180, 160, 176)):
            self.grid.setColumnWidth(column, width)
        self.grid.setMinimumHeight(220)
        self.toolbar.setDataGrid(self.grid)
        body.addWidget(self.grid, 1)
        footer = QHBoxLayout()
        self.summary = fluentqt.Label(self)
        self.summary.setObjectName("dataGridSummary")
        self.summary.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
        self.summary.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
        self.summary.setWordWrap(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.summary, 1)
        save = fluentqt.Button("Save view", self)
        save.setObjectName("dataGridSaveView")
        self.restore = fluentqt.Button("Restore", self)
        self.restore.setObjectName("dataGridRestoreView")
        self.restore.setEnabled(False)
        footer.addWidget(save)
        footer.addWidget(self.restore)
        body.addLayout(footer)
        save.clicked.connect(self.save_view)
        self.restore.clicked.connect(self.restore_view)
        self.toolbar.searchTextChanged.connect(self.apply_filters)
        self.toolbar.filtersChanged.connect(self.apply_filters)
        self.grid.selectionModel().selectionChanged.connect(self.update_summary)
        self.grid.selectRow(2)
        self.update_summary()

    def apply_filters(self, *_):
        self.proxy.setCriteria(self.toolbar.searchText(), self.toolbar.filters())
        self.update_summary()

    def update_summary(self, *_):
        self.summary.setText(f"{self.proxy.rowCount()} of {self.model.rowCount()} projects · {len(self.grid.selectionModel().selectedRows())} selected")

    def save_view(self):
        self.saved = (self.grid.saveColumnState(), self.toolbar.searchText(), self.toolbar.filters())
        self.restore.setEnabled(True)
        fluentqt.Toast.showOrUpdateToast(
            self, "gallery.action-feedback", "View saved for this demo",
            fluentqt.Toast.Success, 2200, fluentqt.Toast.Top,
            QMargins(16, 50, 16, 16),
        )

    def restore_view(self):
        columns, search, filters = self.saved
        self.grid.restoreColumnState(columns)
        self.toolbar.clearFilters()
        self.toolbar.setSearchText(search)
        for key, values in filters.items():
            self.toolbar.setFilterValues(key, values)
        self.update_summary()
        fluentqt.Toast.showOrUpdateToast(
            self, "gallery.action-feedback", "View restored",
            fluentqt.Toast.Success, 2200, fluentqt.Toast.Top,
            QMargins(16, 50, 16, 16),
        )

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout, QWidget

panel = QWidget()
body = QVBoxLayout(panel)
body.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
body.setSpacing(12)
width = fluentqt.ComboBox(panel)
width.setObjectName("listDetailPreviewWidth")
width.setAccessibleName("Preview width")
width.addItems(["Wide preview", "Narrow preview"])
body.addWidget(width, 0, Qt.AlignLeft)
view = fluentqt.ListDetailView(panel)
view.setObjectName("basicListDetailView")
view.setCompactThreshold(520)
view.setMaximumWidth(640)
view.setFixedHeight(156)
body.addWidget(view, 0, Qt.AlignLeft)
list_layout = QVBoxLayout(view.listPane())
list_layout.addWidget(fluentqt.Label("Notes", view.listPane()))
open_button = fluentqt.Button("Open meeting note", view.listPane())
list_layout.addWidget(open_button)
list_layout.addStretch()
detail_layout = QVBoxLayout(view.detailPane())
back = fluentqt.Button("Back to notes", view.detailPane())
back.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.Subtle)
back.setVisible(view.isCompact())
detail_layout.addWidget(back, 0, Qt.AlignLeft)
detail_layout.addWidget(fluentqt.Label("Meeting note", view.detailPane()))
editor = fluentqt.LineEdit(view.detailPane())
editor.setAccessibleName("Note draft")
editor.setText("Discuss the next release")
detail_layout.addWidget(editor)
detail_layout.addStretch()
open_button.clicked.connect(view.showDetail)
back.clicked.connect(view.showList)
view.compactChanged.connect(back.setVisible)
width.currentIndexChanged.connect(
    lambda index: view.setMaximumWidth(640 if index == 0 else 360)
)

import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
application = QApplication.instance()
if application is None:
    fluentqt.prepare_high_dpi_application()
    application = QApplication([])
    fluentqt.initialize_resources()
    application.setFont(fluentqt.font_for_role(fluentqt.FontRole.Body))
from PySide6.QtCore import QMarginsF, QPointF, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QSizePolicy, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

from PySide6.QtCore import QMargins, QPersistentModelIndex, QSignalBlocker, QSize
from PySide6.QtCore import QSortFilterProxyModel
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction, QColor, QIcon, QKeySequence, QPixmap
from PySide6.QtGui import QStandardItem, QStandardItemModel, QRegion
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QLayout


class FileBrowserSample(fluentqt.FluentWidget):
    Draft, Modified, Saved, Folder = range(int(Qt.UserRole), int(Qt.UserRole) + 4)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.model = None
        self.current = QPersistentModelIndex()
        self.filtering = False
        self.new_count = 0
        self.setObjectName("fileBrowserSample")
        self.setMaximumWidth(960)
        self.setMinimumHeight(644)
        body = self.column(self)
        body.setSpacing(fluentqt.Spacing.Medium)
        body.setSizeConstraint(QLayout.SetNoConstraint)
        self.surface = fluentqt.Card(self)
        self.surface.setObjectName("fileBrowserSurface")
        self.surface.setFixedHeight(600)
        fluentqt.set_widget_theme_overrides(self.surface, {"radius": {"control": 8}})
        surface = self.column(self.surface, 1)
        surface.setSizeConstraint(QLayout.SetNoConstraint)
        body.addWidget(self.surface)
        toolbar = self.row(self.surface, 52, fluentqt.Spacing.Medium)
        self.breadcrumb = QWidget(self.surface)
        path = QHBoxLayout(self.breadcrumb)
        path.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        path.setSpacing(fluentqt.Spacing.Medium)
        path.addWidget(fluentqt.FontIcon("ic_fluent_folder_20_regular", self.breadcrumb))
        path.addWidget(self.label("Workspace", secondary=True))
        chevron = fluentqt.FontIcon("ic_fluent_chevron_right_20_regular", self.breadcrumb)
        chevron.setIconSize(fluentqt.Typography.IconSize.Compact)
        path.addWidget(chevron)
        toolbar.addWidget(self.breadcrumb)
        self.folder_title = self.label("Documents", fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
        toolbar.addWidget(self.folder_title)
        self.back = self.button("Files", "fileBrowserBack", fluentqt.Button.Subtle)
        self.back.setIconGlyph(fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Back)
        self.back.setAccessibleName("Back to files")
        toolbar.addWidget(self.back)
        toolbar.addStretch()
        self.wide_search = self.search("fileBrowserSearch")
        self.wide_search.setFixedWidth(204)
        toolbar.addWidget(self.wide_search)
        self.new = self.button("New file", "fileBrowserNew")
        self.new.setIconGlyph(fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Add)
        self.new.setAccessibleName("New file")
        toolbar.addWidget(self.new)
        self.more = self.button("", "fileBrowserMore", fluentqt.Button.Subtle)
        self.more.setIconGlyph(fluentqt.Typography.Icons.More)
        self.more.setAccessibleName("File options")
        self.more.setToolTip(self.more.accessibleName())
        toolbar.addWidget(self.more)
        self.compact_save = self.button("Save", "fileBrowserCompactSave", fluentqt.Button.Accent)
        toolbar.addWidget(self.compact_save)
        surface.addWidget(toolbar.parentWidget())
        surface.addWidget(fluentqt.Divider(self.surface))
        self.view = fluentqt.ListDetailView(self.surface)
        self.view.setObjectName("fileBrowserLayout")
        self.view.setListPaneWidth(320)
        surface.addWidget(self.view, 1)
        listing = self.column(self.view.listPane())
        search_row = self.row(self.view.listPane(), 56, fluentqt.Spacing.Medium)
        self.search_row = search_row.parentWidget()
        self.narrow_search = self.search("fileBrowserCompactSearch")
        search_row.addWidget(self.narrow_search)
        listing.addWidget(self.search_row)
        headings = self.row(self.view.listPane(), 36, 0)
        headings.setContentsMargins(48, 0, 12, 0)
        headings.addWidget(self.label("Name", fluentqt.FontRole.Caption, True))
        headings.addStretch()
        headings.addWidget(self.label("Modified", fluentqt.FontRole.Caption, True))
        listing.addWidget(headings.parentWidget())
        self.files = fluentqt.ListView(self.view.listPane())
        self.files.setObjectName("fileBrowserList")
        self.files.setAccessibleName("Documents")
        self.files.setBorderVisible(False)
        self.files.setScrollChainingEnabled(False)
        self.files.setTrailingTextRole(self.Modified)
        self.files.setIconSize(QSize(20, 20))
        self.files.setSpacing(0)
        self.files.setPlaceholderText("No matching files")
        listing.addWidget(self.files, 1)
        listing.addWidget(fluentqt.Divider(self.view.listPane()))
        footer = self.row(self.view.listPane(), 28, fluentqt.Spacing.Standard)
        self.count = self.label("", fluentqt.FontRole.Caption, True)
        footer.addWidget(self.count)
        listing.addWidget(footer.parentWidget())
        detail = self.column(self.view.detailPane())
        heading = self.row(self.view.detailPane(), 64, fluentqt.Spacing.Large)
        identity = QVBoxLayout()
        identity.setSpacing(fluentqt.Spacing.XSmall)
        identity.setAlignment(Qt.AlignVCenter)
        self.title = self.label("", fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
        self.title.setObjectName("fileBrowserTitle")
        self.title.setMinimumWidth(0)
        identity.addWidget(self.title)
        state = QHBoxLayout()
        state.setSpacing(fluentqt.Spacing.XSmall)
        self.dirty = fluentqt.InfoBadge(self)
        self.dirty.setDisplayMode(fluentqt.InfoBadge.InfoBadgeDisplayMode.Dot)
        self.dirty.setStatus(fluentqt.InfoBadge.InfoBadgeStatus.Caution)
        self.dirty.setBeaconDiameter(5)
        self.dirty.setFixedSize(5, 5)
        self.dirty.setAccessibleName("Unsaved changes")
        state.addWidget(self.dirty)
        self.status = self.label("", fluentqt.FontRole.Caption, True)
        self.status.setObjectName("fileBrowserStatus")
        state.addWidget(self.status)
        state.addStretch()
        identity.addLayout(state)
        heading.addLayout(identity, 1)
        self.save = self.button("Save", "fileBrowserSave", fluentqt.Button.Accent)
        heading.addWidget(self.save)
        detail.addWidget(heading.parentWidget())
        detail.addWidget(fluentqt.Divider(self.view.detailPane()))
        self.editor = fluentqt.TextEdit(self.view.detailPane())
        self.editor.setObjectName("fileBrowserEditor")
        self.editor.setAccessibleName("File contents")
        self.editor.setAutoResizeEnabled(False)
        self.editor.setFrameVisible(False)
        self.editor.setContentMargins(QMargins(24, 24, 24, 24))
        self.editor.setLineHeight(fluentqt.Spacing.ControlHeight.Small)
        self.editor.setScrollChainingEnabled(False)
        detail.addWidget(self.editor, 1)
        detail.addWidget(fluentqt.Divider(self.view.detailPane()))
        footer = self.row(self.view.detailPane(), 28, fluentqt.Spacing.Standard)
        self.file_type = self.label("", fluentqt.FontRole.Caption, True)
        self.position = self.label("", fluentqt.FontRole.Caption, True)
        footer.addWidget(self.file_type)
        footer.addStretch()
        footer.addWidget(self.position)
        detail.addWidget(footer.parentWidget())
        narrow = self.button("Narrow preview", "fileBrowserNarrow", fluentqt.Button.Subtle)
        narrow.setCheckable(True)
        narrow.toggled.connect(self.preview_narrow)
        body.addWidget(narrow, 0, Qt.AlignLeft)
        self.document_icon = self.glyph_icon("ic_fluent_document_text_20_regular", 20)
        self.folder_icon = self.glyph_icon("ic_fluent_folder_20_regular", 20)
        self.model = QStandardItemModel(self)
        names = ["Design assets", "getting-started.md", "layout-notes.md",
                 "architecture.md", "keyboard.md", "roadmap.md", "changelog.md",
                 "theme-tokens.json", "contributing.md", "license.txt",
                 "release-notes.md", "readme.md"]
        dates = ["Oct 18", "11:20", "10:42", "Yesterday", "Oct 18", "Oct 18",
                 "Oct 17", "Oct 17", "Oct 16", "Oct 15", "Oct 15", "Oct 14"]
        for index, (name, date) in enumerate(zip(names, dates)):
            contents = self.layout_notes() if index == 2 else f"# {name}\n\nNotes for this workspace.\n"
            self.add_file(name, date, contents, index == 0)
        self.model.item(0).setData(
            "Design assets\n\nFolder contents\n\napp-icon.svg\ncolor-tokens.json\nREADME.md", self.Draft)
        self.model.item(2).setData(self.layout_notes().split("Next:")[0], self.Saved)
        for index in range(1, 21):
            self.add_file(f"meeting-notes-{index:02d}.md", "Oct 12",
                          f"# Meeting notes {index}\n\nDecisions\n\n"
                          + "Keep the next step small and reviewable.\n" * 40)
        self.proxy = QSortFilterProxyModel(self)
        self.proxy.setSourceModel(self.model)
        self.proxy.setFilterCaseSensitivity(Qt.CaseInsensitive)
        self.proxy.setFilterKeyColumn(0)
        self.files.setModel(self.proxy)
        self.files.selectionModel().currentChanged.connect(self.select_file)
        self.files.clicked.connect(self.open_file)
        self.files.activated.connect(self.open_file)
        self.open_action = QAction(self.files)
        self.open_action.setShortcuts([QKeySequence(Qt.Key_Return), QKeySequence(Qt.Key_Enter)])
        self.open_action.setShortcutContext(Qt.WidgetShortcut)
        self.files.addAction(self.open_action)
        self.open_action.triggered.connect(self.open_file)
        self.back.clicked.connect(self.show_files)
        self.view.compactChanged.connect(self.update_chrome)
        self.view.currentPaneChanged.connect(self.update_chrome)
        self.wide_search.textChanged.connect(self.filter_files)
        self.narrow_search.textChanged.connect(self.filter_files)
        self.editor.textChanged.connect(self.update_draft)
        self.editor.cursorPositionChanged.connect(self.update_position)
        self.save_action = QAction(self)
        self.save_action.setShortcut(QKeySequence.Save)
        self.save_action.setShortcutContext(Qt.WidgetWithChildrenShortcut)
        self.addAction(self.save_action)
        self.save_action.triggered.connect(self.save_file)
        self.save.clicked.connect(self.save_action.trigger)
        self.compact_save.clicked.connect(self.save_action.trigger)
        self.new.clicked.connect(self.new_file)
        self.menu = fluentqt.FluentMenu("File options", self)
        self.menu.addAction("Show current file").triggered.connect(self.reveal_current)
        self.menu.addAction("Clear search").triggered.connect(self.wide_search.clear)
        self.more.clicked.connect(lambda: self.menu.popup(
            self.more.mapToGlobal(self.more.rect().bottomLeft())))
        self.files.setCurrentIndex(self.proxy.index(2, 0))
        self.view.showList()
        self.on_theme_updated()
        self.update_chrome()

    @staticmethod
    def column(parent, margin=0):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(parent)
        layout.setContentsMargins(margin, margin, margin, margin)
        layout.setSpacing(0)
        return layout

    @staticmethod
    def row(parent, height, inset):
        widget = QWidget(parent)
        widget.setFixedHeight(height)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(widget)
        layout.setContentsMargins(inset, 0, inset, 0)
        layout.setSpacing(fluentqt.Spacing.Small)
        return layout

    def label(self, text, role=fluentqt.FontRole.Body, secondary=False):
        label = fluentqt.Label(text, self)
        label.setFluentTypography(role)
        label.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.Fixed)
        if secondary:
            label.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
        return label

    def button(self, text, name, style=fluentqt.Button.Standard):
        button = fluentqt.Button(text, self)
        button.setObjectName(name)
        button.setFluentStyle(style)
        return button

    def search(self, name):
        field = fluentqt.LineEdit(self)
        field.setObjectName(name)
        field.setPlaceholderText("Search files…")
        field.setAccessibleName("Search files")
        icon = fluentqt.FontIcon("ic_fluent_search_20_regular", field)
        icon.setIconSize(16)
        icon.setFixedSize(16, 16)
        icon.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(field)
        layout.setContentsMargins(fluentqt.Spacing.Small, 0, fluentqt.Spacing.Small, 0)
        layout.addWidget(icon, 0, Qt.AlignVCenter)
        layout.addStretch()
        margins = field.contentMargins()
        margins.setLeft(32)
        field.setContentMargins(margins)
        return field

    def glyph_icon(self, glyph, size):
        icon = fluentqt.FontIcon(glyph, self)
        icon.hide()
        icon.setIconSize(size)
        icon.resize(size, size)
        dpr = self.devicePixelRatioF()
        pixmap = QPixmap(round(size * dpr), round(size * dpr))
        pixmap.setDevicePixelRatio(dpr)
        pixmap.fill(Qt.transparent)
        icon.render(pixmap, QPointF(0, 0).toPoint(), QRegion(), QWidget.DrawChildren)
        icon.deleteLater()
        return QIcon(pixmap)

    def on_theme_updated(self):
        if getattr(self, "model", None) is None:
            return
        colors = self.theme_tokens().colors
        self.document_icon = self.glyph_icon("ic_fluent_document_text_20_regular", 20)
        self.folder_icon = self.glyph_icon("ic_fluent_folder_20_regular", 20)
        for row in range(self.model.rowCount()):
            item = self.model.item(row)
            item.setIcon(self.folder_icon if item.data(self.Folder) else self.document_icon)
        secondary = QColor(colors.textSecondary)
        search_text = (f"#{secondary.red():02x}{secondary.green():02x}"
                       f"{secondary.blue():02x}{secondary.alpha():02x}")
        mode = {fluentqt.Theme.Dark: "dark", fluentqt.Theme.HighContrast: "contrast"}.get(
            self.effective_theme(), "light")
        search_theme = {mode: {"textTertiary": search_text}}
        fluentqt.set_widget_theme_overrides(self.wide_search, search_theme)
        fluentqt.set_widget_theme_overrides(self.narrow_search, search_theme)
        self.update()

    def add_file(self, name, modified, contents, folder=False):
        item = QStandardItem(name)
        item.setEditable(False)
        item.setSizeHint(QSize(0, fluentqt.Spacing.ControlHeight.Large))
        for role, value in [(self.Draft, contents), (self.Saved, contents),
                            (self.Modified, modified), (self.Folder, folder)]:
            item.setData(value, role)
        item.setData(f"{name}, modified {modified}", Qt.AccessibleTextRole)
        item.setIcon(self.folder_icon if folder else self.document_icon)
        self.model.appendRow(item)

    def select_file(self, index):
        if self.filtering or not index.isValid():
            return
        source = self.proxy.mapToSource(index)
        if source == self.current:
            return
        self.current = QPersistentModelIndex(source)
        self.title.setText(index.data())
        with QSignalBlocker(self.editor):
            self.editor.setPlainText(source.data(self.Draft))
            self.editor.setReadOnly(bool(source.data(self.Folder)))
        self.update_state()
        self.update_position()
        if not self.view.isCompact():
            self.view.showDetail()

    def open_file(self):
        if self.files.currentIndex().isValid():
            self.view.showDetail()
            self.editor.setFocus()

    def preview_narrow(self, checked):
        if checked:
            self.preview_width = self.width()
        self.setMaximumWidth(400 if checked else 960)
        self.resize(400 if checked else self.preview_width, self.height())

    def show_files(self):
        self.view.showList()
        self.files.setFocus()

    def filter_files(self, text):
        with QSignalBlocker(self.wide_search), QSignalBlocker(self.narrow_search):
            if self.wide_search.text() != text:
                self.wide_search.setText(text)
            if self.narrow_search.text() != text:
                self.narrow_search.setText(text)
        self.filtering = True
        self.proxy.setFilterFixedString(text)
        self.files.setCurrentIndex(self.proxy.mapFromSource(self.current))
        self.filtering = False
        self.update_state()

    def update_draft(self):
        if self.current.isValid():
            self.model.setData(self.current, self.editor.toPlainText(), self.Draft)
            self.update_state()
            self.view.showDetail()

    def save_file(self):
        if not self.current.isValid() or self.current.data(self.Folder):
            return
        self.model.setData(self.current, self.current.data(self.Draft), self.Saved)
        self.model.setData(self.current, "Just now", self.Modified)
        self.model.setData(self.current, f"{self.current.data()}, modified Just now",
                           Qt.AccessibleTextRole)
        self.update_state()

    def new_file(self):
        self.filter_files("")
        self.new_count += 1
        self.add_file(f"untitled-{self.new_count}.md", "Just now", "# Untitled\n\n")
        row = self.model.rowCount() - 1
        self.model.item(row).setData("", self.Saved)
        self.files.setCurrentIndex(self.proxy.mapFromSource(self.model.index(row, 0)))
        self.open_file()

    def reveal_current(self):
        self.filter_files("")
        self.files.scrollTo(self.files.currentIndex())

    def update_state(self):
        folder = bool(self.current.data(self.Folder))
        dirty = not folder and self.current.data(self.Draft) != self.current.data(self.Saved)
        self.dirty.setVisible(dirty)
        self.status.setText("Folder · 3 items" if folder else
                            "Unsaved changes" if dirty else "Saved in memory")
        self.save.setEnabled(dirty)
        self.compact_save.setEnabled(dirty)
        name = self.current.data() or ""
        kind = "Markdown" if name.endswith(".md") else "Plain text"
        self.file_type.setText("Folder" if folder else f"{kind} · UTF-8")
        selected = " · 1 selected" if self.files.currentIndex().isValid() else ""
        self.count.setText(f"{self.proxy.rowCount()} items{selected}")

    def update_position(self):
        cursor = self.editor.textCursor()
        self.position.setText(f"Ln {cursor.blockNumber() + 1}, Col {cursor.positionInBlock() + 1}")

    def update_chrome(self):
        compact = self.view.isCompact()
        detail = compact and self.view.currentPane() == fluentqt.ListDetailView.Pane.Detail
        self.breadcrumb.setVisible(not compact)
        self.folder_title.setVisible(not detail)
        self.back.setVisible(detail)
        self.wide_search.setVisible(not compact)
        self.new.setVisible(not detail)
        self.new.setText("" if compact else "New file")
        self.more.setVisible(compact and not detail)
        self.compact_save.setVisible(detail)
        self.search_row.setVisible(compact)
        self.save.setVisible(not compact)

    @staticmethod
    def layout_notes():
        return (
            "# Layout notes\n\nKeep the browser quiet. Let the document lead.\n\n"
            "## Wide windows\n- List on the left, content on the right.\n"
            "- One divider. No cards inside cards.\n\n## Small windows\n"
            "- Open a file to focus on its contents.\n"
            "- Return to the same place in the list.\n\nNext: refine the empty state."
        )


panel = FileBrowserSample()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    panel.show()
    application.exec()

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QSizePolicy
from fluentqt.particles import ParticleBackdrop

backdrop = ParticleBackdrop()
backdrop.setEffect(ParticleBackdrop.Effect.FlowingRibbons)
backdrop.setBackgroundMode(ParticleBackdrop.BackgroundMode.Solid)
backdrop.setParticleCount(240)
backdrop.setMaximumFrameRate(30)
backdrop.setMinimumHeight(240)
backdrop.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Preferred)

from PySide6.QtCore import QMarginsF, QPointF, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QSizePolicy, QVBoxLayout
from fluentqt.particles import ParticleBackdrop

backdrop = ParticleBackdrop()
backdrop.setEffect(ParticleBackdrop.Effect.FloatingDots)
backdrop.setBackgroundMode(ParticleBackdrop.BackgroundMode.Solid)
backdrop.setMaximumFrameRate(30)
backdrop.setFadeMargins(QMarginsF(260, 0, 0, 0))
backdrop.setMinimumHeight(280)
backdrop.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Preferred)
layout = QVBoxLayout(backdrop)
layout.setContentsMargins(24, 24, 24, 24)
title = fluentqt.Label("Make room for a little motion", backdrop)
title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle)
title.setWordWrap(True)
layout.addWidget(title)
layout.addStretch()
ripple = fluentqt.Button("Create a ripple", backdrop)
ripple.setObjectName("particleRipple")
ripple.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
layout.addWidget(ripple, 0, Qt.AlignLeft)
ripple.clicked.connect(
    lambda: backdrop.triggerRipple(
        QPointF(backdrop.width() * .72, backdrop.height() * .42)
    )
)

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QSizePolicy, QVBoxLayout, QWidget
from fluentqt.particles import ParticleBackdrop

panel = QWidget()
panel.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Preferred)
layout = QVBoxLayout(panel)
layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
layout.setSpacing(12)
backdrop = ParticleBackdrop(panel)
backdrop.setEffect(ParticleBackdrop.Effect.Starfield)
backdrop.setBackgroundMode(ParticleBackdrop.BackgroundMode.Solid)

def add_slider(parent, layout, name, label, unit, minimum, maximum, initial):
    in_grid = isinstance(layout, QGridLayout)
    group = QWidget(parent) if in_grid else parent
    column = QVBoxLayout(group) if in_grid else QVBoxLayout()
    column.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
    column.setSpacing(4)
    text = fluentqt.Label(f"{label}: {initial}{unit}", group)
    slider = fluentqt.Slider(group)
    slider.setObjectName(name)
    slider.setAccessibleName(label)
    slider.setRange(minimum, maximum)
    slider.setValue(initial)
    slider.valueChanged.connect(
        lambda value: text.setText(f"{label}: {value}{unit}")
    )
    column.addWidget(text)
    column.addWidget(slider)
    if isinstance(layout, QGridLayout):
        layout.addWidget(group, 0, layout.count())
    else:
        layout.addLayout(column)
    return slider

class TreeRowDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
    def __init__(self, view, row_height=36):
        super().__init__(view)
        self._view = view
        self._row_height = row_height
        self._check_box_visible = False

    def setCheckBoxVisible(self, visible):
        self._check_box_visible = bool(visible)

    def sizeHint(self, option, index):
        del option, index
        return QSize(0, self._row_height)

    def _background_rect(self, option):
        viewport_width = self._view.viewport().width()
        top = option.rect.top() + 2.0
        height = option.rect.height() - 4.0
        if option.direction == Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft:
            right = option.rect.x() + option.rect.width() - 2.0
            return QRectF(2.0, top, max(0.0, right - 2.0), height)
        left = option.rect.left() + 2.0
        return QRectF(left, top, max(0.0, viewport_width - 2.0 - left), height)

    def _check_box_rect(self, option):
        if not self._check_box_visible:
            return QRectF()
        background = self._background_rect(option)
        rtl = option.direction == Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft
        leading = option.rect.x() + option.rect.width() if rtl else option.rect.x()
        x = leading - 12.0 - 22.0 if rtl else leading + 12.0
        return QRectF(x, background.top(), 22.0, background.height())

    def paint(self, painter, option, index):
        if not index.isValid():
            return
        snapshot = _theme_snapshot(self)
        colors = snapshot["colors"]
        painter.save()
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.TextAntialiasing)
        selected = bool(option.state & QStyle.StateFlag.State_Selected)
        enabled = bool(option.state & QStyle.StateFlag.State_Enabled)
        hovered = bool(option.state & QStyle.StateFlag.State_MouseOver)
        pressed = bool(option.state & QStyle.StateFlag.State_Sunken) and hovered
        background = QColor(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
        if enabled:
            if pressed:
                background = colors["subtleTertiary"]
            elif selected or hovered:
                background = colors["subtleSecondary"]

        background_rect = self._background_rect(option)
        if background.alpha() > 0:
            path = QPainterPath()
            path.addRoundedRect(background_rect, 4.0, 4.0)
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(background)
            painter.drawPath(path)

        text_color = colors["textPrimary"]
        if not enabled:
            text_color = colors["textDisabled"]

        if (
            selected
            and enabled
            and not self._check_box_visible
            and not self._view.selectionIndicatorVisible()
        ):
            progress = max(
                0.0,
                min(float(self._view.selectedIndicatorProgress(index)), 1.0)
            )
            motion_active = self._view.isIndicatorMotionActiveForIndex(index)
            direction = (
                self._view.indicatorMotionDirection()
                if motion_active
                else fluentqt.TreeView.IndicatorVerticalDirection.None_
            )
            hierarchy = (
                self._view.indicatorHierarchyTransition()
                if motion_active
                else fluentqt.TreeView.IndicatorHierarchyTransition.None_
            )
            indicator_width = 3.0
            full_height = 16.0
            indicator_height = full_height * (0.35 + 0.65 * progress)
            rtl = option.direction == Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft
            settled_x = (
                option.rect.x()
                + option.rect.width()
                - 4.0
                - indicator_width
                if rtl
                else option.rect.left() + 4.0
            )
            settled_y = background_rect.center().y() - full_height / 2.0
            remaining = 1.0 - progress
            indicator_x = settled_x
            if (
                hierarchy
                == fluentqt.TreeView.IndicatorHierarchyTransition.Inward
            ):
                indicator_x += (-1.0 if rtl else 1.0) * remaining * 4.0
            elif (
                hierarchy
                == fluentqt.TreeView.IndicatorHierarchyTransition.Outward
            ):
                indicator_x += (1.0 if rtl else -1.0) * remaining * 3.0
            indicator_y = (
                background_rect.center().y() - indicator_height / 2.0
            )
            if (
                direction
                == fluentqt.TreeView.IndicatorVerticalDirection.Down
            ):
                indicator_y = settled_y - remaining * 6.0
            elif (
                direction
                == fluentqt.TreeView.IndicatorVerticalDirection.Up
            ):
                indicator_y = (
                    settled_y
                    + full_height
                    - indicator_height
                    + remaining * 6.0
                )
            indicator = QRectF(
                indicator_x,
                indicator_y,
                indicator_width,
                indicator_height
            )
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            accent = QColor(colors["accentDefault"])
            accent.setAlphaF(accent.alphaF() * progress)
            painter.setBrush(accent)
            painter.drawRoundedRect(indicator, 1.5, 1.5)

        rtl = option.direction == Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft
        cursor_x = (
            option.rect.x() + option.rect.width() - 12.0
            if rtl
            else option.rect.x() + 12.0
        )

        def take_leading_rect(width):
            nonlocal cursor_x
            x = cursor_x - width if rtl else cursor_x
            rect = QRectF(x, background_rect.top(), width, background_rect.height())
            cursor_x += (-1.0 if rtl else 1.0) * (width + 4.0)
            return rect

        if self._check_box_visible:
            check_area = take_leading_rect(22.0)
            state = index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.CheckStateRole)
            if state is None:
                state = Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
            state = Qt.CheckState(state)
            box = QRectF(
                check_area.center().x() - 9.0,
                check_area.center().y() - 9.0,
                18.0,
                18.0
            )
            box_path = QPainterPath()
            box_path.addRoundedRect(box, 3.0, 3.0)
            if state in (
                Qt.CheckState.Checked,
                Qt.CheckState.PartiallyChecked,
            ):
                painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
                painter.setBrush(colors["accentDefault"])
                painter.drawPath(box_path)
                check_font = QFont("FluentQt Icons")
                check_font.setPixelSize(12)
                painter.setFont(check_font)
                painter.setPen(Qt.GlobalColor.white)
                painter.drawText(
                    box,
                    Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter,
                    "" if state == Qt.CheckState.Checked else ""
                )
            else:
                painter.setPen(QPen(colors["strokeDefault"], 1.5))
                painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
                painter.drawPath(box_path)

        chevron_rect = take_leading_rect(20.0)
        if index.model().hasChildren(index):
            icon_font = QFont("FluentQt Icons")
            icon_font.setPixelSize(12)
            painter.setFont(icon_font)
            painter.setPen(text_color)
            painter.save()
            painter.translate(chevron_rect.center())
            rotation = self._view.chevronRotation(index)
            painter.rotate((-1.0 if rtl else 1.0) * rotation * 90.0)
            painter.translate(-chevron_rect.center())
            painter.drawText(
                chevron_rect,
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter,
                "" if rtl else ""
            )
            painter.restore()

        glyph = str(index.data(TREE_ICON_GLYPH_ROLE) or "")
        if glyph:
            glyph_color = text_color
            color_value = index.data(TREE_ICON_COLOR_ROLE)
            if isinstance(color_value, QColor) and color_value.isValid():
                glyph_color = color_value
            icon_font = QFont("FluentQt Icons")
            icon_font.setPixelSize(16)
            painter.setFont(icon_font)
            painter.setPen(glyph_color)
            painter.drawText(
                take_leading_rect(22.0),
                Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter,
                glyph
            )

        if rtl:
            text_rect = QRectF(
                background_rect.left() + 8.0,
                background_rect.top(),
                max(0.0, cursor_x - background_rect.left() - 8.0),
                background_rect.height()
            )
        else:
            text_rect = QRectF(
                cursor_x,
                background_rect.top(),
                max(0.0, background_rect.right() - cursor_x - 8.0),
                background_rect.height()
            )
        painter.setPen(text_color)
        painter.setFont(option.font)
        text = str(index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) or "")
        painter.drawText(
            text_rect,
            (Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight if rtl else Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
            | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter,
            painter.fontMetrics().elidedText(
                text,
                Qt.TextElideMode.ElideLeft if rtl else Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight,
                int(text_rect.width())
            )
        )
        painter.restore()

    def editorEvent(self, event, model, option, index):
        if event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonPress and self._check_box_visible:
            if self._check_box_rect(option).contains(event.position()):
                return True
        if event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease:
            position = event.position()
            if self._check_box_visible and self._check_box_rect(option).contains(position):
                current = index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.CheckStateRole)
                current = (
                    Qt.CheckState(current)
                    if current is not None
                    else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
                )
                next_state = (
                    Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
                    if current == Qt.CheckState.Checked
                    else Qt.CheckState.Checked
                )
                model.setData(index, next_state, Qt.ItemDataRole.CheckStateRole)

                def cascade(parent_index):
                    for row in range(model.rowCount(parent_index)):
                        child = model.index(row, 0, parent_index)
                        model.setData(
                            child,
                            next_state,
                            Qt.ItemDataRole.CheckStateRole
                        )
                        cascade(child)

                def roll_up(child_index):
                    parent_index = child_index.parent()
                    if not parent_index.isValid():
                        return
                    states = [
                        Qt.CheckState(
                            model.index(row, 0, parent_index).data(
                                Qt.ItemDataRole.CheckStateRole
                            )
                        )
                        for row in range(model.rowCount(parent_index))
                    ]
                    if all(state == Qt.CheckState.Checked for state in states):
                        parent_state = Qt.CheckState.Checked
                    elif all(state == Qt.CheckState.Unchecked for state in states):
                        parent_state = Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
                    else:
                        parent_state = Qt.CheckState.PartiallyChecked
                    model.setData(
                        parent_index,
                        parent_state,
                        Qt.ItemDataRole.CheckStateRole
                    )
                    roll_up(parent_index)

                cascade(index)
                roll_up(index)
                return True
            if (
                model.hasChildren(index)
                and self._background_rect(option).contains(position)
            ):
                self._view.toggleExpanded(index)
                return True
        return super().editorEvent(event, model, option, index)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):

        self.arrange_timer = QTimer(self)
        self.arrange_timer.setSingleShot(True)

        if self.itemCount() != 2:
            return

        self.setFixedHeight(
            520 if not self.isSpatialEnabled() else (560 if stacked else 360)
        )

            QVector3D(
                0 if stacked else -164,
                -140 if stacked else 0,
                item.position().z()
            )
        )
        self.items()[-1].setPosition(
            QVector3D(0 if stacked else 164, 110 if stacked else 0, -50)
        )

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self.arrange_timer.start(0)

import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QSizePolicy, QVBoxLayout, QWidget
def font_icon_pixmap(glyph, size, color):
    icon = fluentqt.FontIcon(glyph)
    icon.setIconSize(size)
    icon.setColor(color)
    icon.resize(size, size)
    return icon.grab()

def show_feedback(anchor, message, severity=fluentqt.Toast.Informational):
    problem = severity in (fluentqt.Toast.Warning, fluentqt.Toast.Error)
    fluentqt.Toast.showOrUpdateToast(
        anchor, "gallery.action-feedback", message, severity,
        4500 if problem else 2200, fluentqt.Toast.Top,

    )



class SampleSurface(fluentqt.FluentWidget):
    def __init__(self, parent=None, spacing=12):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._action_glyphs = []
        self.setSizePolicy(
            QSizePolicy.Policy.MinimumExpanding,
            QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed,
        )
        self.content_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.content_layout.setContentsMargins(16, 14, 16, 16)
        self.content_layout.setSpacing(spacing)
        self.content_layout.setAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft
        )

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        del event
        tokens = self.theme_tokens()
        colors = tokens["colors"]
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.setPen(QPen(colors["strokeCard"], 1.0))
        painter.setBrush(colors["bgCanvas"])
        radius = float(tokens["radius"]["overlay"])
        painter.drawRoundedRect(
            self.rect().adjusted(0, 0, -1, -1), radius, radius
        )

    def set_action_glyph(self, action, glyph):
        for index, (stored_action, _stored_glyph) in enumerate(
            self._action_glyphs
        ):
            if stored_action is action:
                self._action_glyphs[index] = (action, glyph)
                self._update_action_icon(action, glyph)
                return
        self._action_glyphs.append((action, glyph))
        self._update_action_icon(action, glyph)

    def _update_action_icon(self, action, glyph):
        colors = self.theme_tokens()["colors"]
        icon = QIcon()
        for size in (16, 20, 24):
            normal = font_icon_pixmap(
                glyph, size, colors["textPrimary"]
            )
            disabled = font_icon_pixmap(
                glyph, size, colors["textDisabled"]
            )
            for mode, state in (
                (QIcon.Mode.Normal, QIcon.State.Off),
                (QIcon.Mode.Active, QIcon.State.Off),
                (QIcon.Mode.Selected, QIcon.State.Off),
                (QIcon.Mode.Normal, QIcon.State.On),
                (QIcon.Mode.Active, QIcon.State.On),
            ):
                icon.addPixmap(normal, mode, state)
            icon.addPixmap(
                disabled, QIcon.Mode.Disabled, QIcon.State.Off
            )
            icon.addPixmap(
                disabled, QIcon.Mode.Disabled, QIcon.State.On
            )
        action.setIcon(icon)

    def on_theme_updated(self):
        for action, glyph in self._action_glyphs:
            self._update_action_icon(action, glyph)
        super().on_theme_updated()
